Applying systematic analysis across all five methods:

1. CAPABILITY ENUMERATION:
Phase A — CENSUS: Business functions served: User Onboarding, Winner Notification, Customer Support, Incident Management
Phase B — ANALYSIS: User Onboarding (1 workflow - prototype), Winner Notification (3 workflows - intentional redundancy for testing), Customer Support (3 workflows - iterative development), Incident Management (1 workflow - infrastructure)

2. DEPENDENCY GRAPH CONSTRUCTION:
Phase A — CENSUS: External systems: Gmail, Google Sheets, Anthropic Claude, Google Docs
Phase B — ANALYSIS: Gmail (7/8 workflows = 88%), Google Sheets (6/8 = 75%), Anthropic Claude (3/8 = 38%), Google Docs (2/8 = 25%). Gmail and Sheets are critical dependencies with massive blast radius.

3. DOMAIN-COVERAGE VERIFICATION:
Phase A — CENSUS: Business domains from taxonomies and workflow content: 1. FAQ, 2. Account/Verification, 3. Payment/Billing, 4. Technical/Bug, 5. Resale/Transfer, 6. Feedback, 7. User Onboarding, 8. Lottery Operations, 9. Winner Management, 10. Customer Communication, 11. Support Analytics, 12. Incident Response, 13. Anti-bot Protection, 14. Queue Fairness, 15. Pricing Transparency, 16. Phase B — COVERAGE CHECK: 1. FAQ (Support workflows) ✓, 2. Account/Verification (Support classification) ✓, 3. Payment/Billing (Support classification) ✓, 4. Pricing Transparency (No automation) GAP, 16-19. Sentiment handling (Classification workflows) ✓

4. OPERATIONAL COHERENCE CHECK:
Phase A — CENSUS: 7 inactive workflows with significant execution history, 1 active infrastructure workflow
Phase B — ANALYSIS: Major contradiction - revenue-critical workflows (lottery, support) are inactive despite high business importance and execution history

5. LIFECYCLE COMPLETENESS TRACE:
Phase A — PARTICIPANT CENSUS: User journey: Unregistered → Registered → Verified → Lottery Participant → Winner/Non-winner → Purchaser/Expired
Phase B — STATE MACHINE: Gaps identified for non-winners, lottery losers, and post-purchase states
Phase C — COMPLEMENTARY OUTCOME CHECK: Winner notifications exist, but no automation for lottery losers (GAP), expired purchase windows (GAP), or rejected verification (GAP)

COMPLETENESS VERIFICATION: All 19 domain items received verdicts. All workflow populations analyzed for complementary cases. Multiple silent drop-off points identified.
